_comment: Docs-site redirect map: old doc path -> new doc path, both relative to /docs and without the .md extension.
Renaming a published doc changes a live URL, so every rename MUST add an entry here or external links,
bookmarks and search results break silently. scripts/build-docs-index.js copies this to
frontend/public/docs-redirects.json; DocsViewer consults it before fetching and issues a replacing
client-side navigation, so deep links keep working. Entries are permanent - never prune them.
Directory renames need one entry per page, plus the directory index itself.
